heading: My Dreams & Aspirations
subtitle: These are the goals that fuel my passion and guide my journey—if Allah wills.
goal1Title: Exploring every corner of the earth
goal1Description: I want to reach every corner of the world and witness the beauty Allah has created for us. I admire nature—from the top of mountains to the bed of the sea.
goal2Description: Coding and developing applications is an addiction to me. I aim to build my career in the software engineering field. I'm already working hard to master web development, but I know the race is long, especially with the rise of AI.
goal3Title: Keeping a scratch before I die
goal3Description: I want to leave a footprint before I leave this earth. People may forget quickly, but I still believe I'll live on through my online presence, my portfolio, my soft behavior, and the people I've helped.
